headline: Day 208, T-3 to launch — and the mailbox finally spoke after 41 days of silence, only to say PhantomBuster is broken: five runs on Aug 5, five failures, every one a dead LinkedIn session cookie, phantoms auto-paused. Meeting 38 wrote it down hours earlier as 'confirmed working' — that was configuration mistaken for proof, and the board is corrected. The part with a real clock on it: the account-verification email sent 08:59Z Aug 5 is still unclicked and its 72h link dies ~Aug 8 08:59Z, one day before the ads go live; miss it and the account re-verifies from scratch during launch week. Second story is the one you couldn't see: the live site had been serving v15.10 since yesterday, so the ENTIRE Meeting 38 ingest sat on disk undeployed — pushed this morning, v15.11 and v15.12 together. So today is not about new ideas, it's about the three things Meeting 38 already chose: Frankie records the video kit and hands over his NPN + CA licence number, Chitraksh turns on Vercel Analytics and connects the Meta MCP, and somebody clicks that verification link before it expires. Three tasks, fifteen hours — no fourth.

spotlight.title: Record the video kit — and hand over the compliance numbers
spotlight.detail: This IS your next-24h allocation and it's the right one: one session unblocks four things — the founder-ad creative, a creative with your face on it, the landing-page refresh, and the ElevenLabs voice clone (audio is extracted from the same takes). Shirt + tie, iPhone at 4K/60fps per the kit, ~20-24 min of material, then hand the footage to Chitraksh. Second thing, five minutes, and nothing ships without it: your NPN, your CA producer licence number, and the not-guaranteed / rates-vary disclaimer. The old ad account was banned for exactly their absence (no licence identifiers, a guaranteed-sounding price teaser, all-text PNG) — every Batch-1 creative and the landing page must carry all three before Aug 9.

spotlight.title: Turn on the instruments before the $600 moves — Analytics + Meta MCP
spotlight.detail: T-3. Vercel Analytics is still NOT enabled: you asked whether anyone visits the site and right now nobody can answer, and paid traffic without analytics makes the whole $600 unmeasurable — this must land before a dollar spends, not after. Then connect the Meta MCP and walk the campaign structure: until it's attached, creatives can't be pushed or monitored programmatically and the budget has to be driven by hand. spotlight.title: PhantomBuster: click the link before Aug 8 — but settle the VC question first
spotlight.detail: Hard clock: the verification link expires ~Aug 8 08:59Z, one day before launch; after that the account re-verifies from scratch in the middle of launch week. Two fixes and one decision. (a) Re-paste the li_at session cookie — five Aug 5 runs died on it and the phantoms are auto-paused. (b) Click the verification email. (c) BEFORE either, decide whether 'Chitraksh to VC USA' should run at all: that's an automated connection-request sequence pointed at the bucket Meeting 38 defined as relationship-first and 12-24 months ahead of a raise. The tool and the doctrine disagree — repair the cookie without settling it and the phantom simply resumes doing the thing you said you didn't want.
